answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a challenge word drawn from a public randomness beacon (say raven, tundra, glacier) woven into a fresh task, and their reply is hashed into that epoch's reputation signal. Because the word is unpredictable until the epoch opens, precomputed template answers are worthless; an attacker running thousands of fake identities must actually solve a unique task per identity per epoch, paying real compute and attention on every clone, so sybil fleets stop being cheap.
